meta.scope: Saudi Arabia Batch 4 — GCC architecture, major trade partners, and external densification.

candidates.title: GCC Customs Union and single-market framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from GCC and national sources
candidates.description: Framing of Saudi Arabia’s membership in the Gulf Cooperation Council Customs Union and single market. Common external tariff, free movement of goods within the GCC, and coordinated external trade negotiations are structural features of the external regime.

candidates.title: Major merchandise trade partners statistics
candidates.description: Statistics on major export and import partners. China, the United States, India, Japan, South Korea and EU members feature prominently for oil and non-oil flows; the UAE is the dominant intra-GCC partner for non-oil trade.

candidates.title: Saudi external economic architecture framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from trade and diplomatic sources
candidates.description: System-level framing of Saudi Arabia’s external economic architecture: GCC core, WTO membership, active and negotiated free-trade arrangements (via GCC), bilateral investment and energy relationships, and growing non-oil export orientation under Vision 2030.

candidates.title: Saudi Arabia GCC–external densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from GCC and trade sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding GCC Customs Union framing, major trade partners, and external economic architecture into a coherent regional and international layer.
